declared_base: Rahlfs–Hanhart Septuaginta, second revised edition (2006), provisional continuation authorized by the user
scope: All 1,287 inherited English units read for editorial review. Selected main-text inspections only; no new full-book Greek collation or independent specialist review.

checks.result: The parenthetical naming clause and threefold blessing were inspected. The blessing addresses human recipients; the English now uses you.
Direct address to God retained. The embedded command in 11:12 addresses a human and uses your. Crystal and the inherited negative in 11:25 remain.
Punctuation now distinguishes the three recipients from the command at 12:4. Direct address to God remains in 12:13.
Repeated exceedingly, the prayer and inherited children reading retained. No harmonization with another textual tradition.

checks.scope: Selected 15:14–16 and 15:22–24; main-text window within 15:6–38 retrieved
checks.result: The inherited conditional interpretation at 15:14 received English grammatical revision. The exact Greek clause relationship remains a priority for independent syntactic review; this check does not settle it.
Vow addressed to God retained. The mixed complaint against God and Moses at 21:5 remains flagged for addressee review. Serpent wording in 21:8 retained.
Gog, the star and man imagery, Beor and Og retained. The difficult opening of 24:17 remains provisional.
Punctuation distinguishes recipients from speech in 32:2. The conditions in 32:20–22 remain.
